vulnerabilities.recommendation: No action required. Liquibase does not run a Netty server.

ratings.justification: Server-side vulnerability. Liquibase never accepts inbound connections; Netty is only used as a client transport.

analysis.detail: Netty codec vulnerability fixed in 4.1.133.Final / 4.2.13.Final. Liquibase is a database migration CLI tool that does not run any network server. Netty is a transitive dependency from Azure SDK, Cassandra driver, and MongoDB driver — used only as a client-side transport for outbound connections. There is no inbound socket for an attacker to exploit.
